description: This file defines a class that compiles the {eval} tag for the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for handling attributes and generating PHP code to evaluate inline templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Eval
classes.description: A class that compiles the {eval} tag in Smarty templates, enabling dynamic code evaluation within templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate a Smarty template or assign its output to a variable.
